svg.text: Weekly taken rate by responder, with how the other pings ended
A. Taken rate = pings taken / pings sent. Coloured: the four responders who nearly stopped receiving pings. Grey: the other 12.
B. How each responder's pings ended each week (count of pings)
Each bar is one week. All panels share the same 0–21 scale. Source: rook.pings (outcome by sent_at week); weekly totals match callout-history.csv.
